newsitem.title: USA: National Steel completes coke battery sale.
newsitem.headline: National Steel completes coke battery sale.

text.p: National Steel Corp said Thursday it completed the sale of its coke oven battery at its Great Lakes Division to DTE Energy Co for about $225 million.
The transaction will result in an after-tax loss of about $20 million, the company said. But the impact on future earnings will be positive, it said.

About $154 million of the proceeds will be used to strengthen National Steel's balance sheet by repaying outstanding debt on the coke battery. The company is evaluating options for the rest of the proceeds.
